messages:
alex (oncall): FYI incident-2026-07-12 hit SEV2 paging earlier. We mitigated but there was customer latency for a subset of EU users. Need to schedule an after-action review (AAR) / PIR. Who can facilitate? Prefer someone not on the rotation this week.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-07-12 | SEV2 | Service: realtime-ingest | Pages: 3 | Duration: 47m. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/realtime-ingest|realtime-ingest runbook>

maria: I can facilitate. I'm remote next week but flexible mornings PDT. Do we want a backup facilitator?
samir: I can be backup, but heads up — travelling Tue-Thu (UTC offset weird). Prefer Mon or Fri.
jordan: happy to attend. request: include SLO impact numbers in pre-read so we can keep timeline focused.
emily: I can take notes/actions if someone else facilitates. also can prepare a short timeline from logs.

alex (oncall): thanks. proposal: Mon Jul 19 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PDT or Fri Jul 23 15:00 UTC / 08:00 PDT. Both 60min. Which works? Also we should lock a facilitator and an action-owner for the long-lived remediation.
maria: Mon 16:00 UTC works for me. samir ok?
samir: Mon is OK for me though I might drop off early — i'll be +0530. I can be backup facilitator and pick up action owner for the caching fix if we decide.

alex (oncall): perfect. maria will facilitate, samir backup + remediation owner. emily will do notes. jordan please bring SLO numbers (per-route latency percentiles).
jordan: copying numbers into pre-read now. will also paste a short query you can run during the review:
```
# Quick SLO query
select percentile(latency_ms, 50, 95, 99), count(*) from ingress where route='eu-v1' and ts > now() - 24h
```

ops-scheduler-bot: Creating tentative event: "AAR: incident-2026-07-12 (maria facilitator)" Mon Jul 19 16:00 UTC — sending invites to participants.
ops-scheduler-bot: Added buffer slot of 15min before and after for on-call handoff. Calendar invite includes conferencing link and pre-read placeholder.

alex (oncall): pre-read draft (please edit):
```
- Incident summary (timeline)
- Impact: affected customers & SLOs
- Root cause hypothesis
- Proposed remediations + owners
- Open questions
```

maria: I'll own circulating pre-read by EOD Thu so people have time. Can we get exec summary at the top for any PM/CS folks?
emily: I'll attach the timeline & logs extract to the pre-read. jordan will add the SLO table.
samir: also want to raise a follow-up item: confirm autoscale thresholds for EU pool. i'll add that as remediation candidate and it's fine if I take owner.

alex (oncall): attendee ask: please RSVP in the calendar. If you can't make the two slots, tell us availability and we'll attempt a quick 30m follow-up with the key owners.
maria: quick note on facilitation—i'll run a tight timeline: 10m timeline, 15m RCA discussion, 20m actions, 15m wrap + owners. EMs and PMs please join first 20m.
jordan: added SLO snapshot to pre-read. linking: <https://redwood.internal/docs/incidents/2026-07-12-slo-snapshot|SLO snapshot>
emily: draft pre-read uploaded: <https://redwood.internal/wiki/aar/2026-07-12-draft|aar pre-read>. maria feel free to edit.

alex (oncall): small logistic: since this impacts EU customers, I'll add a customer-impact line for CS in the invite and ping owner to prepare customer comms if needed. who is CS lead on this account?
jordan: that's Priya — i'll loop her in once the invite is final.

maria: ok i'll facilitate. samir backup and remediation owner for caching thresholds. emily notes. alex will send final calendar and include Priya. ops-scheduler-bot: Event confirmed.

alex (oncall): thanks all. Action list (quick):
- maria: facilitate AAR (Mon Jul 19 16:00 UTC)
- emily: upload timeline & take notes during session
- jordan: SLO numbers + exec summary table in pre-read
- samir: owner for autoscale/caching remediation candidate (follow-up)
- alex: add CS lead to invite, send final invite + pre-read link by EOD Thu

samir: noted. i'll draft remediation plan if the group agrees during AAR.
maria: I'll kick off and keep us on time. If anyone knows they can't attend, please DM alex so we can cover. :thumbsup:
alex (oncall): I'll follow up with calendar invite + reminder 24h before. Thanks team.
